content.overview: IPM begins with conditions that reduce pest/pathogen establishment and spread. Sanitation, exclusion, clean stock, crop spacing, environmental management, removal of infested material and movement control can reduce pressure before chemical intervention is considered.

vocabulary.definition: A production practice that makes the crop system less favorable to pest or pathogen establishment, reproduction or spread.
Physical removal, exclusion, trapping or barriers used to reduce pest/pathogen pressure.
Removal or control of infested/infected material, debris, weeds, standing water or other reservoirs that sustain a problem.

sections.title: Prevention has compounding value
sections.body: Incoming-material inspection, sanitation, clean propagation material, weed/debris control and appropriate environmental management reduce the number of opportunities for pests and pathogens to establish.

sections.title: Control the pathway that explains the pattern
sections.body: An edge-associated flying pest, a media-associated fungus gnat problem and a humidity-driven disease pattern call for different cultural or mechanical responses. Match the tactic to the biology and distribution.

sections.title: Cleaning and disinfection are separate operations
sections.body: Physical removal of organic matter improves the effectiveness of later disinfection. Sanitizer choice and use remain label- and facility-controlled.

workedExamples: Repeated fungus-gnat pressure linked to chronically wet media requires correction of the moisture/source condition in addition to any direct pest intervention.
commonMistakes: Using sanitation as a vague catch-all without identifying the pathway.
Applying environmental changes that create new crop stress.
Assuming surface disinfection works through heavy organic debris.
content.practicalApplication: Take one pest or disease scenario and identify one exclusion, one sanitation/source-reduction, one environmental/cultural and one mechanical tactic. State what evidence would verify each tactic is working.
content.summary: Cultural and mechanical controls work best when they target the actual biological pathway and are verified with the same disciplined monitoring used for diagnosis.
